info.name: Pure activity equipment API
equipment
Lists all equipment

params.name: size
params.description: Number of returned equipment per request.

params.description: The offset for the returned list. 0 or null value is from the start

params.description: The order of the list, must be a value from /equipment/orderings

items.docs: Lists all equipment in the Pure instance. If you need to filter the equipment returned, see the POST version which supports additional filtering.

info.name: Query operation for equipment

items.docs: Lists equipment in the Pure instance that matches the provided query, similar to the GET version, instead of using parameters to alter the response, an JSON document is posted with the request. The JSON document contains fields for all the parameters available for the GET version, but also additional filtering options.
